title: Predictable Scaling: Efficient Model Exploration via Scaling-Law Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.23453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating candidate changes (hypotheses) to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of GPU-hours, severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore. We introduce Predictable Scaling (PS), a systematic framework that exploits empirically verified regularity conditions to predict full-scale model performance from small-scale proxies. PS constructs scaled-down variants via composable scaling functions along distinct resource axes, and projects metrics to the target scale via curve fitting with calibrated uncertainty estimates. We compare three prediction strategies of increasing expressiveness: even the simplest (raw proxy) achieves prediction error within the empirical noise floor of repeated-run variance; the most expressive (Gaussian Process) provides an indicative 15% relative MAE improvement and calibrated uncertainty. translated_title: 可预测扩展：基于扩展定律预测的高效模型探索
translated_abstract: 评估推荐模型的候选变更（假设）需要进行全规模训练，消耗数千GPU小时，严重限制了工程师能够实际探索的假设空间。我们提出了可预测扩展，这是一个系统性框架，利用经过实证验证的规律性条件，从小规模代理模型预测全规模模型的性能。PS通过沿不同资源轴的可组合扩展函数构建缩小版模型，并通过带有校准不确定性估计的曲线拟合将指标投射到目标规模。我们比较了三种表达能力递增的预测策略：即使是最简单的（原始代理）也能达到与重复运行方差的经验噪声水平相当的预测误差；表达能力最强的（高斯过程）则提供了15%的相对MAE改进和校准的不确定性估计。在两个复杂度递增的排序模型上的评估——一个……
tldr: 该论文提出“可预测扩展”（PS）框架，通过沿资源轴构建小规模代理模型并结合曲线拟合与不确定性校准，从代理实验预测全规模推荐模型性能，从而将原本需数千GPU小时的模型改进假设评估变得高效可行。
